name: clatter-shake
title: Clatter Shake
description: A hanging tag drops in on its string and clatters side to side until it hangs still. Pure CSS keyframes, played once on mount.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `ClatterShake`. Import it from `@/components/ui/clatter-shake` and render `<ClatterShake key={run} aria-label="A hanging tag swinging to a stop" />`.

It plays once on mount; change its `key` to play it again.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--clatter-shake-surface`, `--clatter-shake-string`, `--clatter-shake-tag`, `--clatter-shake-hole`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: no motion; the tag hangs at rest.
